issues.detail: Missing error handling for API failures and edge cases in onboarding and charging flows.
Excessive explanatory text and tables increase file length without adding actionable code.
Implementation relies on Node.js 20+ and stripe-node, limiting compatibility with other runtime environments.

scenarios.name: onboard-seller-with-link
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets every rubric requirement, whereas Response A omits many required fields and uses the wrong API endpoints.

scenarios.name: charge-buyer-destination
